content: Prisma ORM v7 (Nov 2025, current npm v7.8.0) removed the Rust query engine, is now fully TypeScript, 3x faster queries, 90% smaller bundle -- closes the historic gap with Drizzle. For traditional (non-edge/serverless) Node servers valuing migration tooling and DX, Prisma remains the safer default; Drizzle still wins for edge/serverless cold-start-sensitive deployments. Given Skillshare runs as a long-lived Docker container, Prisma is the better fit.
